label: Adaptive loop, the service fails part way through
description: The package holds one adaptive questionnaire and the first next-question call returns a question. Once that question is answered the service fails with HTTP 500. The answer already given is not lost: the step can be sent again from the result before it. This is a finding about the environment, not about the member or the questionnaire. It departs from DTR 2.0.1 on purpose in one way: the package carries no draft response, so the first next-question call is the one this tool builds from nothing.
basis: Synthetic. Shaped to DTR 2.0.1, the version this tool is held to, from the guide's own examples where it has them, with this project's placeholders for every value the guide leaves open. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service reports a failure of its rules in the middle of the adaptive loop is not known. This file models an HTTP 500 carrying a FHIR OperationOutcome. The marker is the boolean form, which DTR 2.0.1 allows and later versions do not. The questionnaire inside each response has no url of its own and is derived from the one in the package, which is how DTR 2.0.1 ties the two. Each step holds only what the service changes at that point, the questions and the status: the mock returns the response it was sent with those replaced, so the response that comes back carries the coverage, the order, the intended use, the subject and the time it was authored that were sent.

nextQuestion.rule: The step is chosen from the answers in the QuestionnaireResponse that was sent. With no answer to the first question the service asks it. With any answer to it the service fails.
